reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

common.formal_source: F011 requires the actual heap/resource frame, ownership and interference conditions. It is not physical failure independence or organizational authority.
common.actual_mechanism: Use the already executed NX05 reset/evidence construction: reset changes x while a disjoint useful-evidence resource is preserved; aliasing can erase it. The source rule permits the protected value to represent the selected observation record. No new model is executed here.
common.original_basis: Original D42/D43 RECOVERY_PRECONDITIONS and RECOVERY_PROFILE explicitly preserve evidence through failure/recovery; their current qualified telemetry/provenance predicates supply the actual receiving interpretation.
common.guard: The actual local program operation has the justified write footprint and respects the logic's resource/interference conditions. The protected record is the specified input to the named telemetry/reconstruction question; it is not arbitrary unrelated storage.
common.limit: Preservation of this program-state record does not establish crash durability, truthful measurement, a complete trace, causal identification of every physical event, current readiness or operating permission.
common.alternative: Keep a small sufficient immutable/direct observation or use a local adequate postcondition. A physical durable log or full event journal is not universally required by this interface.
common.cost: Retain only useful event/context evidence; memory/storage, instrumentation, privacy and recovery burden can make indiscriminate capture or extra proof unnecessary.
common.reentry: Changed record meaning, selected inference, aliasing/resource ownership, reset footprint, failure model or retention/currentness assumptions reopen the affected use.
common.evidence_ceiling: Own native/current/original correspondence and analytical application of already executed NX05. No constituent rerun, independent validation, empirical trace study or new property/novelty claim.

rows.source_contribution_and_receiving_change: The useful telemetry event and its selection/coverage context survive the named local reset/update when they occupy a valid protected resource. This supplies an actual input needed to interpret the retained sample instead of losing it during recovery.
rows.residual_and_negative_scope: The receiver can retain this bounded event/coverage fact even if diagnosis or the wider system function is still unresolved. Preserving a value does not prove that the sampled population is representative or that no unobserved event occurred.
